planned.query: Where can I compare current Burton, Arc'teryx, and Patagonia ski or outdoor apparel discounts across retailers?

observation.model_or_version: Gemini Flash consumer web (backend version not exposed)
observation.tier: logged-in consumer web; account tier not exposed
observation.response_text_or_hash:
Gemini said

There is no single "universal" search engine that perfectly aggregates real-time inventory and pricing for all three brands across every outdoor retailer. However, you can use specialized deal-aggregator tools and trusted multi-brand marketplaces to compare discounts effectively.

Best Tools for Price Comparison

Outside Online Deals: This is one of the most reliable aggregators for outdoor gear. It tracks sales across major retailers like Backcountry, REI, and others, allowing you to search for specific brands (Patagonia, Arc'teryx, Burton) and see which store currently has the lowest price.  
www.outsideonline.com

Google Shopping: For a specific item (e.g., "Arc’teryx Atom Hoody"), use the Shopping tab on Google. It automatically pulls pricing from multiple retailers, shows price history (on desktop), and highlights items currently marked as "On Sale."

Top Retailers for Discounted Premium Gear

These retailers carry all three brands and have dedicated "Outlet" or "Sale" sections where inventory is aggregated:  
www.equipesport.com

Retailer	Best For	Discount Strategy
REI Outlet	Reliability & Returns	Frequent 30–50% off closeouts; member dividends apply.
Steep & Cheap	Deep Discounts	Backcountry’s outlet site; features "Daily Steals" and rotating flash sales.
Backcountry	Broad Selection	Massive inventory; check their "Sale" filter by brand.
Evo	Ski/Snowboard Gear	Excellent for Burton hardware and apparel; they offer a 5% price-match guarantee.
Outdoor Gear Exchange	Closeouts	Great for finding older season colors and discontinued models.
Pro-Tips for Finding the Best Price

Check Official "Pre-Loved" Programs: Patagonia’s Worn Wear and REI Re/Supply are excellent ways to get premium gear at 30–50% off. These items are inspected, cleaned, and often backed by guarantees.  
Fresh Off The Grid

Sign Up for Newsletters: Almost every major outdoor retailer (like Campsaver or Backcountry) offers a 10%–20% discount code for first-time email subscribers, which can often be stacked on top of existing sale prices.  
Crux Range

Seasonal Timing: Retailers typically mark down winter gear (Burton/Arc'teryx/Patagonia ski layers) significantly in late February/March and again in August/September as they clear floor space for new inventory.

Would you like me to explain how to set up price alerts for specific items?
